def grid(ax, ref, rows, names, title, rolelab=None):
    n_r, n_c = len(rows), len(ref)
    Mi=np.zeros((n_r,n_c))
    for i,row in enumerate(rows):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c=="gap": Mi[i,j]=0.5
            else: Mi[i,j]= 1.0 if c[0]==ref[j][0] else 0.0
    ax.imshow(Mi, cmap=plt.cm.colors.ListedColormap(["#c44536","#9a9a9a","#2a7f62"]), vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
    for i in range(n_r):
        for j in range(n_c):
            ax.text(j,i,rows[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,color="white")
    ax.set_xticks(range(n_c)); ax.set_xticklabels(ref, rotation=90, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(n_r)); ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10, loc="left")
    if rolelab:
        for j,r in enumerate(rolelab): ax.text(j, -0.75, r, rotation=90, fontsize=6, ha="center", va="bottom", color="#444")
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,n_c,1), minor=True); ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,n_r,1), minor=True)
    ax.grid(which="minor", color="white", lw=1.2); ax.tick_params(which="minor", length=0)
